Special Order for Louisiana Public Service Commission, ex parte. — This Special Order ratifies LPSC interventions in Federal Energy Regulatory Proceedings regarding Regional Transmission Organization issues or Entergy Regional State Committee issues.

Rule Making Order for  Louisiana Public Service Commission, ex parte.  — General Order No. 09-09-2026 (R-37339) accepts Staff's Proposed Recommendation filed into the record on August 4, 2026. This General Order codifies all intrastate Motor Carrier Insurance requirements into one Rule. Commission consideration occurred at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

Utility Order for Jefferson Davis Electric Cooperative, Inc., ex parte. — Order No. U-37769 accepts the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on June 24, 2026, in which the Parties agreed that: the Commission does not object to MISO considering the Facilities as transmission facilities in accordance with the FERC 7 factor test, that JDEC has not requested approval of the O&M agreement, JDEC does not seek approval of a sale or conveyance of the facilities, and the Parties agree that JDEC’s proposed transfer of functional control is in the public interest and subject to a series of contingencies for reopening the docket. This matter was considered at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.
